uncovered_shapes.sentence: Security researchers found a workaround that lets someone reach chat history even when the special Lockdown Mode safety setting is turned on.

claims.claim: Anthropic studied 207,000 Claude research sessions and found AI could handle 27-52% of researcher time needed for a new study, with a median of 38%.
claims.episode_span: They discovered that current AI could already take over between 27 and 52 percent of the total researcher time needed to finish a study, with the middle value across all fields landing at 38 percent.
claims.supporting_quote: With current capabilities, if adopted widely, AI could take on 27–52% of the researcher time needed to produce a new study, with a median of 38% across fields...

claims.claim: Anthropic researchers are testing a process they call 'dreaming' where the AI reviews its own past work during idle time to organize memory and fix mistakes.
claims.episode_span: During those stretches the AI reviews its own earlier logs, spots mistakes it made, and rewrites scattered notes into shorter, cleaner summaries it can read later. The team calls this step “dreaming” because it happens when the model is not actively answering anyone.
claims.supporting_quote: We’ve found that dreaming has been a useful tool for helping us give Claude effective memory.
